description: Recompute fa_users.level from EARNED XP now that migration 315 can tell earned from attendance. fa_users.level is a cache written only when XP is awarded, so after 315 the live learner still displayed rank 'operative' — bought with 1465 XP of daily logins against 250 XP of demonstrated work — until their next award happened to refresh it. Written in Python rather than SQL so the thresholds come from xp_to_level() instead of being duplicated into a CHECK-style ladder that would drift from it
